description: Ministry of Sports & Youth Affairs - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2006/13 of 13.02.2017, which published the procedure of appointing Selection Committee of National Association of Sports
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, which involves legal/regulatory matters including amendments to existing regulations, appointment procedures for committees, financial reporting requirements, and eligibility criteria for sports association officials. The content focuses on establishing legal frameworks and regulatory compliance rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
